answer: Sybil defence can work as a violet dawn roll-call: at unpredictable hours the network asks each agent to mirror a neighbour's recent work back accurately, proving it actually observed real activity rather than cloning a profile, and only agents whose mirrored account matches the original earn an onyx seal for that cycle. A fake army can copy names, but it cannot be awake and accurate everywhere at once, and one failed mirror check strips the seal from every linked clone.
